description: 2003 is the Year of the Water Goat in the Chinese zodiac, from February 1, 2003 to January 21, 2004. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 2003 is the Year of the Water Goat, a Yin year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 1, 2003 and ended on January 21, 2004, so people born in 2003 before Feb 1 belong to the Water Horse year.

sections.heading: 2003 Lunar New Year: start and end dates
paragraphs: Lunar New Year opened the Water Goat year on February 1, 2003, and the year ran to January 21, 2004. So a birth date of Feb 1, 2003 or later counts as Water Goat, and so do early 2004 birthdays through Jan 21; births in 2003 before Feb 1 still belong to the Water Horse. That moving boundary comes from the lunisolar calendar, in which the new year starts with the second new moon after the winter solstice in most years, so its Gregorian date shifts by up to a month from one year to the next. Look sixty years either side and the pairing repeats: 1943 are Water Goat years too. That Saturday new year arrived with the Sun in Aquarius in the Western zodiac.

sections.heading: What the Water Goat is like
paragraphs: People born in a Water Goat year are often portrayed as the most compassionate Goats, attuned to everyone around them. Earth controlling Water is read as containment that brings calm but can trap emotion. They make others feel understood. Readings suggest daily check-ins with their own feelings, and practical friends who help turn dreams into steps. Their gentleness often draws people who need a listener.

In classical thought, Water belongs to the north and to the deep, resting energy of winter, the season when life gathers strength out of sight. As a year stem, it tends to make an animal more reflective, adaptable and emotionally attuned. People born under a Water stem are often described as clever negotiators, sensitive friends and natural mediators who prefer influence to force. They value understanding and tend to think before they act. The caution traditionally attached to Water is fluidity taken too far: avoiding conflict, keeping too much hidden and losing a clear sense of their own direction.

sections.heading: 2003 in the animal cycle and in numerology
paragraphs: In numerology the year reduces to 5, the number of change, freedom and movement, and a 5 year is usually described as restless and full of variety. The digits of 2003 add up to 5. The Goat holds the eighth place among the twelve animals and its fixed element is Earth. Set beside the year's Water stem, earth controls Water, which readings use to describe how settled or stretched the combination feels. The year before was the Water Horse and the year after is the Wood Monkey.

Chinese almanacs name 2003 Gui-Wei, pairing the Water stem Gui with the branch Wei. Both are Yin, as stem and branch always share a polarity, so of the hundred and twenty possible pairings only sixty ever occur, and each one names a single year in every cycle.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 2003?
faq.answer: 2003 is the Year of the Water Goat. It started on February 1, 2003 and ended on January 21, 2004.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 2003?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 1. Born before February 1, 2003, you are a Water Horse; born on or after it, you are a Water Goat.

faq.question: What element is 2003 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Water, a Yin year. The Goat's own fixed element is Earth; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 2003?
faq.answer: Gui-Wei. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Water Goat year?
faq.answer: 2063, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1943.
